summary: Genenta Science S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing a Nasdaq ticker change from GNTA to SAEN effective at the open on November 4, 2026, and adoption of the commercial brand Saentra Forge, approved by the board on October 20, 2026. No share issuance, cancellation, exchange, or modification occurs; legal name, Italian jurisdiction, ADS depositary arrangements with Bank of New York, and Exchange Act registration remain unchanged. The rebrand reflects a January 2026 pivot toward strategic industrial consolidation in security-regulated sectors. No deal terms, pricing, or advisory mandates are disclosed. What to watch: any subsequent acquisition announcements under the new brand.
